anomalies.observed: The root schematic page (Sheet: /, File: Meshinger.kicad_sch) is blank apart from the frame and title block; it does not show the three hierarchical sheet symbols required to instantiate the child sheets.
anomalies.expected: The root sheet should instantiate exactly the three hierarchical sheets: SkylabModule, EthernetAndPower, and EPD_Driver.

evidence.quote: Root page title block: Sheet: /, File: Meshinger.kicad_sch; the page contains no symbols or sheet instances.
The top sheet `Meshinger.kicad_sch` instantiates exactly three hierarchical sheets: `SkylabModule.kicad_sch`, `EthernetAndPower.kicad_sch`, and `EPD_Driver.kicad_sch`.

anomalies.impact: Without the hierarchical sheet instances, the child sheets are not part of the schematic hierarchy/netlist, so the board would omit the main WiFi module, power circuitry, and EPD driver described in the specification.

anomalies.observed: On the EPD_Driver sheet, J1 pin 3 is marked with a no-connect symbol and is not wired to the Q1 source / R1 current-sense node.
anomalies.expected: Q1's source should return through R1 to GND and also feed back to J1.3 (RESE), closing the EPD boost-converter control loop.

evidence.quote: EPD_Driver sheet: J1 pin 3 has a no-connect X and no wire to the R1/Q1 source sense node.
Q1's source (`Net-(Q1-S)`) returns through `R1` (0.47 Ω) to GND and also feeds back to `J1.3` (`RESE`), closing the control loop entirely within the EPD module and external power stage

anomalies.impact: The boost-converter current-sense feedback to the EPD panel is open, which can prevent the display power stage from regulating correctly or cause the e-paper display not to update.
